OpenNeuro GraphQL API, no key, fetched 2026-09-24; latestSnapshot.validation and summary.totalFiles. A band is drawn only where both groups hold at least 15 datasets, which
excludes the over-10,000-file band. Ratios are of medians; p from a seeded permutation test on the pooled difference. CAVEAT: a warning is not designed as a quality score,
and this plate does not claim the validator is wrong — only that its warning count cannot be used as one.
